versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.3

- Updated author information to Canlah AI.
- Added homepage field (https://canlah.ai).
- No functional or behavioral changes to the skill logic or pipeline.
- Documentation otherwise unchanged.

- Improved documentation with detailed workflow and philosophy, emphasizing academic integrity and citation correctness.
- Outlines a 3-wave parallel agent pipeline for faster, higher-quality thesis and report writing.
- Explicitly documents a strict policy and tools to prevent and detect hallucinated/fake citations.
- Provides step-by-step guidance for data preparation, chapter writing, and LaTeX assembly.
- Clarifies scenarios for using this skill versus related tools (e.g., ml-paper-writing).
- Adds concrete agent assignments and best practices for figures, improving reproducibility and output quality.
